INSERT INTO collection_materialized_items (
                    materialization_id,
                    collection_id,
                    materialization_key,
                    item_key,
                    media_type,
                    media_id,
                    position,
                    order_key,
                    visible,
                    hidden_reason,
                    evaluated_at
                ) VALUES (
                    $1, $2, $3, $4, ($5::text)::media_type, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, NOW()
                )
